name: Kelington Group Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为股息派发、股份上市及公司秘书变更等事项，未披露业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或合约信息。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长22.1%，净利润同比增长25.7%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements mainly covered dividend payments, share listings, and changes of company secretary, with no disclosed information on business segment expansion, new businesses, reductions, or contracts. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue grew 22.1% year-on-year and net profit grew 25.7% year-on-year.
